title: Private-Network AI Licensing Model — Child NFT as License/Account Object
summary: Design discussion proposing a hierarchical NFT model where per-company/person child NFTs act as private-network license/tenant objects, with spendable AI credits as their children, a payment router, and a public-canonical/private-mirror architecture.
notes: Ambiguity between ADR and DOC: the document makes strong architectural recommendations (license-NFT-over-credit-NFT, public-canonical/private-mirror) with concrete struct sketches, but lacks ADR hallmarks (no Status field, no number, no explicit Context/Decision/Consequences sections, no Accepted/Proposed marker). It is framed as a design discussion/rationale rather than a locked decision, so it is classified as DOC. The synthesizer may want to promote portions of this to a future ADR.
